environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running behind an nginx reverse proxy configured for TLS termination only (proxy_pass to localhost:8080). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No request filtering or inspection at any layer. The nginx config passes all query parameters unmodified to the Flask application. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume.

config.proxy: nginx 1.24 with ssl_certificate and proxy_pass only
